name: giannis13
caption:
TRADE COURT, CASE #3: 3 PICKS LATER 🎮🏀 Our 2013 pick was No. 12. Giannis went No. 15. We'd traded that pick for Kyle Lowry.

• July 11, 2012: Lowry from Houston for Gary Forbes and a future first
• That first became the 12th pick in 2013, sent on to Oklahoma City: Steven Adams
• Giannis went 15th to Milwaukee: 2 MVPs, a 2021 title
• Lowry: our 2019 title

Lowry and a ring, or a shot at Giannis? Would you undo it?

Your verdict: comment W or L 👇
Case #4 drops tomorrow night. Follow so you don't miss it.

beats.head: 3 PICKS LATER
beats.name: GIANNIS
beats.vo: Giannis went three picks after ours. And we'd already traded our pick away.

beats.head: WHERE IT WENT
beats.name: ADAMS
beats.vo: But we'd already traded that pick. It went through Houston to Oklahoma City. The Thunder took Steven Adams.
beats.dlg: THE PICK ENDED UP IN OKC:|STEVEN ADAMS, NO. 12.

beats.head: WHAT WE GOT
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Why'd we trade it? For Kyle Lowry. And Kyle Lowry won us a title.
beats.dlg: WE TRADED IT FOR LOWRY.|HE WON US A RING.

beats.head: THE WHAT IF
beats.name: GIANNIS
beats.vo: Giannis? Two MVPs and a title in Milwaukee. Fourteen teams passed on him. Would we have?
beats.dlg: GIANNIS: 2 MVPS, A TITLE.|14 TEAMS PASSED ON HIM.

beats.head: THE VERDICT
beats.vo: Did we win this trade? W or L. Case four, tomorrow night.
beats.dlg: DID WE WIN THIS TRADE?|W OR L? CASE #4: TOMORROW NIGHT.

facts.claim: 2013 NBA draft: Steven Adams selected 12th (No. 12) by Oklahoma City (from Toronto via Houston); Giannis Antetokounmpo selected 15th (No. 15) by Milwaukee, three (3) picks later; fourteen (14) teams picked before him; two (2) NBA MVP awards and an NBA championship in 2021.
On July 11, 2012, Lowry was traded to the Toronto Raptors in exchange for Gary Forbes and a future first round pick. Lowry won the 2019 NBA championship with Toronto.
